meta.title: How the examiner was kept from seeing the answers
meta.subtitle: A calendar split: everything the examiner can read was issued before 1 June 2026; everything it is graded on was issued after.

events.title: 2017: corpus begins
events.detail: Modern EB-1A AAO decisions harvested from 2017 on.

events.title: 2025: 25 decisions hand-labelled
events.detail: Hand-labelled to check the parser (94% of fields right).

events.title: 31 May 2026: last citable decision
events.detail: Search is filtered to decisions issued before the cutoff; every cited passage is checked.

events.title: 1 Jun 2026: cutoff, test set starts
events.detail: 145 EB-1A merits decisions, June to September 2026.

events.title: June: threshold fitted on 34
events.detail: 34 decisions pick the risk threshold, then they are set aside.

events.title: 30 Sep 2026: last test decision
events.detail: Facts only: verdict words removed before the examiner sees them.

events.title: 11 Nov 2026: graded, 0 leaks
events.detail: 5,864 cited passages checked against the cutoff: 0 violations.

events.title: 12 Nov 2026: blind check 68/68
events.detail: Owner relabelled 5 decisions from the PDFs: 68 of 68 fields agree.

cards.title: Why a calendar split
items: A random split leaks: later decisions quote earlier ones
The test decisions did not exist when the index was built
Any passage from on or after 1 June stops the run

cards.title: What the score means
items: Recall 0.99: it rarely misses a rejected criterion
At a threshold it ties always saying not met
Copying the Director, an oracle, still wins
